meta.reason: The build container's egress policy returns HTTP 403 at CONNECT for thuexemaynguyentu.com (see docs/AUDIT.md section 1). No live request was made, so no live SEO field is recorded here and none may be assumed.
how_to_capture: GitHub Actions: run the manual workflow 'SEO snapshot (live, read-only, manual)' and download the artifact seo-before

or from a network that can reach the site: node tools/seo/discover.mjs --base https://thuexemaynguyentu.com --out reports/seo-urls.full.csv && node tools/seo/snapshot.mjs --base https://thuexemaynguyentu.com --urls reports/seo-urls.full.csv --out reports/seo-before.json --sitemap-out reports/sitemap-urls-before.json --delay 600 --mode live
